name: Iida Rintarou
source:
One of the original participants.

None of the other participants can ever tell what he's thinking. He often speaks in a playful tone that makes him come off as innocent. However, opposed to this personality, he makes sharp comments towards the others that stick out against his normal speech.

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Rintarou_Iida]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
